notes: Config-driven regulatory tables per spec requirement. Update when rules change.

SAVE.notes: Court order vacated. Affected borrowers must pick new plan by 2026-09-30.

IBR.note: Only IDR plan with permanent status. Partial-financial-hardship requirement removed.

consolidationDeadline.note: Deadline to consolidate FFEL/Perkins/Parent PLUS while preserving IDR/PSLF eligibility. Past this date, those loans permanently lose IDR/PSLF eligibility.

autopayDiscount.eligibilityNote: Direct Loans first disbursed on or after 2012-07-01. Not collected on the form, so shown to any federal-loan holder with an appropriate caveat rather than asserted as certain.
autopayDiscount.note: Raised from the longstanding 0.25% to 1%, temporarily. Applies regardless of repayment strategy chosen -- no eligibility analysis, no trade-off, does not compete with the ranked strategies. Sourced from ed.gov/NASFAA reporting; VERIFY before launch.

saveTransition.note: Not a single universal deadline -- each borrower gets a 90-day window starting when their servicer's individual notice goes out, in waves from mid-2026 through early 2027. Missing the window moves the borrower to Standard/Tiered Standard automatically. Time in SAVE forbearance earns no PSLF/IDR credit. Sourced from secondary reporting; VERIFY before launch.

substantialIllegalPurposeRule.notes: Excludes employers found to have substantial illegal purpose. Applied prospectively only.

povertyGuidelines.note: HHS annual poverty guidelines: household of 1, plus a flat amount per additional person. Sourced from secondary reporting; VERIFY against the Federal Register notice before launch, and refresh at each annual update.

rapRules.note: 11 brackets stepping 1%-10% of AGI, one point per $10k, capped above $100k. perDependentMonthlyReduction lowers the bill itself; principalMatchCap is a separate mechanic -- RAP credits up to $50/month of principal reduction even when the payment does not cover it, which is what lets a low RAP payment still amortize instead of growing forever. Both happen to be $50; they are not the same $50. Sourced from secondary reporting on P.L. 119-21; VERIFY against the statute before launch.

forgivenessTaxTreatment.note: Federal treatment only; state conformity varies and is not modeled. The temporary federal exclusion for discharged student debt expired at the end of 2025, so IDR forgiveness (IBR, RAP) is treated as taxable federal income in the year of discharge. PSLF forgiveness has its own separate, longstanding statutory exclusion (not the expired pandemic-era one) and remains tax-free. This is a live legislative area -- VERIFY before launch.

idrPlans.name: RAP
idrPlans.note: Uses AGI-based bracket lookup instead. Forgives at 360 qualifying payments (30 years).
